dialogues.speaker: Ms. Yu
dialogues.text: Hello. Are you interested in doing some work for the Ministry of Civil Affairs?

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Yu
dialogues.text: Yes, the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Yu
dialogues.text: My name's Ms. Yu, and I'm a resource manager with the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Yu
dialogues.text: By resource management, we don't just mean the management of material goods. We also manage information and human resources.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Yu
dialogues.text: I trust that you, too, understand how important resource management is to a city that prizes commerce as much as Liyue does.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Yu
dialogues.text: Exchanging material for manpower and intelligence, and using all three to solve issues — that's our Ministry's specialty.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Yu
dialogues.text: To put it more plainly, you help us, we pay you. Haha.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Yu
dialogues.text: But there are still more details to it than just that, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Yu
dialogues.text: Go ahead, have a look for yourself. You can see what work is available to you now.
